samples.summary: Image read path still short-circuits API keys, so the delta's new "a key dies with its minter's membership" invariant is not enforced there
samples.evidence: `assertCanRead` returns early on `if (user?.isApiKey) { if (user.workspaceId === resolvedWorkspaceId) return; ... }` (image-read.controller.ts:96-99) — exactly the shortcut this delta deleted from `WorkspaceScopeGuard` (workspace-scope.guard.ts:34) and from `ApiV1FoldersController.isManager` (folders.controller.ts:76-86). `ApiV1ImageReadController` is guarded by `OptionalCombinedAuthGuard` only (line 41) and is the one v1 controller that does NOT mount `WorkspaceScopeGuard`, so it never reaches the new `assertMember` call. Result: after an owner is removed from a workspace, every key they minted stops listing/deleting documents and folders (403) but still streams that workspace's image blobs indefinitely — the guard doc-comment's claim that this check "is what makes removal revoke them" holds for every v1 route except this one. Impact is contained: read-only, and image ids are unguessable UUIDs.

samples.summary: Membership is now looked up twice per mutating request (guard + handler), each lookup doing its own slug resolve
samples.evidence: `WorkspaceScopeGuard.canActivate` now calls `resolveId` and `assertMember` for every caller (workspace-scope.guard.ts:31-38), and `assertMember` itself calls `resolveId` again (workspace.service.ts:223-230). `remove` (documents.controller.ts:176) and `ApiV1FoldersController.isManager` (folders.controller.ts:81) then repeat the same `assertMember` because they need `member.role`. That is 2 extra queries on every delete/move on top of the guard's, on a surface explicitly built for scripted CLI loops (`files.controller.ts:53` raises the throttle to 600/min). Correctness is unaffected — the guard has already resolved `params.workspaceId` to a UUID so the second `resolveId` is a no-op — but the role could be threaded from the guard onto `request` instead.
